Override.loadingscreentip: ‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Weapons degrade with use. A heavily worn barrel will frequently jam. Don't forget to repair at the Gunsmith Fabricator.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖The visual appearance of a weapon in hands and its color in inventory change based on condition. Hover over it to check exact durability.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Standard weapons lose effectiveness underwater. Use specialized underwater arms for aquatic missions.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Without aiming attachments, you must rely on instinct. A laser sight or optical scope will restore the aiming reticle.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Utilize different fire modes. 2-round burst increases accuracy, while 3-round burst helps manage recoil.

‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Struggling with strong recoil? Weapons have two types: vertical (muzzle climb) can be controlled by pulling down, horizontal (side-to-side spread) is tamed with specific muzzle devices.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖For better vertical recoil control, install a vertical compensator. A horizontal compensator effectively counters horizontal spread.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Vertical recoil recovery speed heavily depends on your Weapons skill. Higher skill means faster recentering after shots.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Horizontal recoil cannot be controlled by the player, but higher Weapons skill slows its accumulation during sustained fire.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Hitting an enemy induces ballistic shock, disorienting them. Expansive and rubber bullets cause particularly severe pain.

‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖The intensity of pain from gunshot wounds is felt less with high Weapons skill. If you have the ‖color:gui.blue‖Neurotrauma‖end‖ mod installed, morphine can alleviate the suffering.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Firing without ear protection will deafen you. Use earplugs or active headphones to avoid tinnitus and blurred vision.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Open the Animated Arms settings from the ESC menu to change keybinds, disable afflictions, and configure other mod options.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖A lowered helmet visor not only conceals identity but also protects against pepper spray and partially mitigates flashbang effects.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Raise the helmet visor to use a gas mask or night vision device. Lower it for face protection in CQC and against non-lethals.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Some helmets feature integrated systems like active headphones (stun protection) or maSKS (gas protection), saving equipment slots.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Use different armor plate types: Kevlar - lightweight, Steel - reliable, Ceramic - maximum protection but fragile.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Customize your weapon at the Gunsmith Fabricator: scopes, suppressors, tactical lights, and recoil compensators.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Use the ballistic shield for cover and to stun enemies with its flash.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖The single-shot grenade launcher and RPG "Hydrostrike" can utilize various projectiles, including kinetic and HEAT rounds.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Neuroparalytic gas causes suffocation and impaired motor functions. Carry Atropine as an antidote.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Pepper grenades and sprays are effective against unprotected targets. A diving suit or mask provides immunity.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖All revolvers can be spun with a button. ‖color:gui.yellow‖*Feel like Ocelot from MGS.*‖end‖
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Some helmets, like the clown helmet, feature a built-in cassette player for creating a unique atmosphere.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖A suicide function is available on all weapons. Use it in hopeless situations to avoid capture (e.g., on RP servers).
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Hover over a weapon to see the ammo count in its magazine. Transparent magazines allow visual confirmation.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Weapons left in water will slowly rust. Try not to lose your gun in Europa's depths.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖You can unload ammo from magazines. Hold the magazine and press the action button. To load, drag ammo onto the magazine.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖New weapons and schematics can be found across Europa: on factions, outposts, and derelict submarines.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Keybinds are configured in the Animated Arms settings from the ESC menu. You can also toggle combat afflictions and other mod features there.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Most weapons and ammunition are crafted at the Gunsmith Fabricator. Study blueprints and plan your resources in advance.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Grenades in this mod are more lethal compared to vanilla, and each grenade has its own unique shrapnel count.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Tactical laser allows you to move without slowdown while aiming - use this tactical advantage.

‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖This mod offers two playstyles: lethal (like most weapon mods) and pacifist - you can stack pain with expansive or rubber bullets and almost completely immobilize enemies.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Soviet weapons generally wear out slower and perform worse than NATO counterparts, but NATO weapons have faster wear but higher effectiveness.

‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖This mod is one of the first I've created. Surprisingly, it turned out well. Huge thanks to the creator of Guns Enhanced for help! And yes... you expected a tip here, but no...

‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖The mod visualizes where your and other characters are looking. Combined with the enhanced zoom, this allows you to literally "read" players' actions, such as when they are managing their inventory.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Most equipment, weapons, and ammunition are now crafted at a dedicated Weapons Fabricator. If needed, it can also be created at a regular fabricator.
‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖Use your configured interaction key to open the interaction menu. You can change it in the Animated Arms settings from the ESC menu.

‖color:gui.green‖Animated Arms: ‖end‖The interaction menu has a "Point" function. If one hand is occupied — you'll snap your fingers, if both are full — you'll clap, and if you're near a door — you'll knock on it.
